title: Creationism
problem: No Nature check: boosts every damaging spell.
notes: In-game test: Creationism: cast a Nature spell and a non-Nature spell; only the Nature spell gets the bonus. Fix: H: add the Nature test

release_notes.intended: Changes the Intelligence used by damaging Nature spells.
release_notes.actual: The game applied it to every damaging spell, of any class.
release_notes.fix: Now only damaging Nature spells are affected.
